# ENCE and MICE - Strong Scaling Plots

## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
cutoff <- 0.50

tag <- sprintf("cutoff%02d", round(cutoff * 100))
scaling_file <- sprintf("section_4_1_ENCE_strong_scaling_%s.rds", tag)

scaling <- readRDS(scaling_file)
```

## Helper Functions

```{r helper_functions, message=FALSE}
report_metrics <- function(true, pred, method_name, elapsed) {
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((pred - true)^2))
  cat(method_name, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Time:  ", round(elapsed, 2), "seconds\n")
  cat("RMSE:  ", rmse, "\n")
  cat("Bias %:", sum(pred - true) / sum(true) * 100, "\n")
  cat("R2:    ", 1 - sum((pred - true)^2) / sum((true - mean(true))^2), "\n")
  cat("SRMSE: ", rmse / mean(true), "\n\n")
}

plot_obs_pred <- function(observed, predicted, method_name = "Method") {
  op <- par(pty = "s")
  on.exit(par(op))
  lims <- range(c(observed, predicted), na.rm = TRUE)
  plot(observed, predicted,
       xlim = lims, ylim = lims,
       xlab = "Observed", ylab = "Predicted",
       main = paste(method_name, ": Observed vs Predicted"),
       pch = 16, cex = 0.5, col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.12))
  abline(0, 1, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
  grid()
}
```

## Unpack

```{r unpack, results='hold'}
meta <- scaling$meta
cat("Section 4.1 Strong Scaling\n")
cat("cutoff:", meta$cutoff, " K:", meta$K, " seed:", meta$seed,
    " stations:", meta$n_stations, " observed:", meta$n_observed,
    " n_years:", length(meta$years),
    " years:", paste(meta$years, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
cat("description:", meta$description, "\n")
cat("run_time:   ", format(meta$run_time), "\n")
cat("hostname:   ", meta$hostname, " job:", meta$slurm_job_id,
    " nodelist:", meta$slurm_nodelist, "\n")
cat("R version:  ", meta$r_version, "\n")
cat("core_grid:  ", meta$core_grid, "\n\n")

core_grid <- meta$core_grid
true_y    <- scaling$true_y
ENCE_y    <- scaling$ENCE_y
MICE_y    <- scaling$MICE_y
ENCE_time <- scaling$ENCE_time
MICE_time <- scaling$MICE_time
ENCE_time_mat <- scaling$ENCE_time_mat
MICE_time_mat <- scaling$MICE_time_mat
ENCE_rmse <- scaling$ENCE_rmse
ENCE_val  <- scaling$ENCE_val
ENCE_rmse_list <- scaling$ENCE_rmse_list
ENCE_val_list  <- scaling$ENCE_val_list
MICE_rmse_list <- scaling$MICE_rmse_list
```

```{r metrics, results='hold'}
report_metrics(true_y, ENCE_y, "ENCE (1 core)", ENCE_time["1"])
report_metrics(true_y, MICE_y, "MICE (1 core)", MICE_time["1"])
```

## Timings

```{r timings, results='hold'}
cat("Cumulative wall time (s), summed over", meta$K, "folds:\n")
print(rbind(ENCE = round(ENCE_time, 2), MICE = round(MICE_time, 2)))

cat("\nPer-fold wall time, ENCE (rows = folds, cols = cores):\n")
print(round(ENCE_time_mat, 2))
cat("\nPer-fold wall time, MICE (rows = folds, cols = cores):\n")
print(round(MICE_time_mat, 2))

ENCE_mean <- colMeans(ENCE_time_mat)
ENCE_sd   <- apply(ENCE_time_mat, 2, sd)
MICE_mean <- colMeans(MICE_time_mat)
MICE_sd   <- apply(MICE_time_mat, 2, sd)

cat("\nENCE mean +/- sd per core count:\n")
print(rbind(mean = round(ENCE_mean, 2), sd = round(ENCE_sd, 2)))
cat("\nMICE mean +/- sd per core count:\n")
print(rbind(mean = round(MICE_mean, 2), sd = round(MICE_sd, 2)))
```

```{r speedup, results='hold'}
ENCE_speedup_mat <- ENCE_time_mat[, 1] / ENCE_time_mat
MICE_speedup_mat <- MICE_time_mat[, 1] / MICE_time_mat

ENCE_speedup_mean <- colMeans(ENCE_speedup_mat)
ENCE_speedup_sd   <- apply(ENCE_speedup_mat, 2, sd)
MICE_speedup_mean <- colMeans(MICE_speedup_mat)
MICE_speedup_sd   <- apply(MICE_speedup_mat, 2, sd)

cat("ENCE speedup (per-fold, vs 1 core) mean +/- sd:\n")
print(rbind(mean = round(ENCE_speedup_mean, 2), sd = round(ENCE_speedup_sd, 2)))
cat("\nMICE speedup (per-fold, vs 1 core) mean +/- sd:\n")
print(rbind(mean = round(MICE_speedup_mean, 2), sd = round(MICE_speedup_sd, 2)))

ENCE_efficiency <- ENCE_speedup_mean / core_grid
MICE_efficiency <- MICE_speedup_mean / core_grid
cat("\nENCE efficiency (speedup / cores):\n")
print(round(ENCE_efficiency, 2))
cat("\nMICE efficiency (speedup / cores):\n")
print(round(MICE_efficiency, 2))
```

## Scatterplots

```{r scatterplots, results='hold'}
plot_obs_pred(true_y, ENCE_y, "ENCE (1 core)")
plot_obs_pred(true_y, MICE_y, "MICE (1 core)")
```

## Convergence (1 core run)

```{r ence_convergence_plot, results='hold'}
col_rmse <- "#234ec2"
col_val  <- "#c20d0d"

plot(ENCE_rmse, type = "b", col = col_rmse, pch = 15,
     xlab = "Cycle", ylab = "Internal RMSE (between cycles)",
     main = "ENCE Convergence (1 core)")
grid()

plot(ENCE_val, type = "b", col = col_val, pch = 17,
     xlab = "Cycle", ylab = "Validation RMSE (masked cells)",
     main = "ENCE Validation RMSE (1 core)")
grid()
```

```{r mice_histories, results='hold'}
cat("MICE rmse_histories (1 core run): ", length(MICE_rmse_list), "folds x",
    length(MICE_rmse_list[[1]]), "imputations (m)\n\n")
cat("Fold 1:\n"); print(MICE_rmse_list[[1]])
```

## Strong Scaling Plots

```{r scaling_time_plot, results='hold'}
col_ence <- "#eb7500"
col_mice <- "#7008d1"

plot(core_grid, ENCE_mean, type = "b", col = col_ence, pch = 15,
     xlab = "Cores", ylab = "Wall time (s)",
     main = "Strong Scaling: ENCE")
arrows(core_grid, ENCE_mean - ENCE_sd, core_grid, ENCE_mean + ENCE_sd,
       angle = 90, code = 3, length = 0.05, col = col_ence)
grid()

plot(core_grid, MICE_mean, type = "b", col = col_mice, pch = 17,
     xlab = "Cores", ylab = "Wall time (s)",
     main = "Strong Scaling: MICE")
arrows(core_grid, MICE_mean - MICE_sd, core_grid, MICE_mean + MICE_sd,
       angle = 90, code = 3, length = 0.05, col = col_mice)
grid()
```

```{r scaling_speedup_plot, results='hold'}
plot(core_grid, ENCE_speedup_mean, type = "b", col = col_ence, pch = 15,
     xlim = range(core_grid), ylim = range(core_grid),
     xlab = "Cores", ylab = "Speedup (vs 1 core)",
     main = "Strong Scaling Speedup: ENCE vs MICE")
arrows(core_grid, ENCE_speedup_mean - ENCE_speedup_sd, core_grid, ENCE_speedup_mean + ENCE_speedup_sd,
       angle = 90, code = 3, length = 0.05, col = col_ence)
lines(core_grid, MICE_speedup_mean, type = "b", col = col_mice, pch = 17)
arrows(core_grid, MICE_speedup_mean - MICE_speedup_sd, core_grid, MICE_speedup_mean + MICE_speedup_sd,
       angle = 90, code = 3, length = 0.05, col = col_mice)
abline(0, 1, col = "grey40", lty = 2)
grid()
legend("topleft", legend = c("ENCE", "MICE", "Ideal"),
       col = c(col_ence, col_mice, "grey40"), pch = c(15, 17, NA), lty = c(1, 1, 2))
```
```{r efficiency plot, results='hold'}
plot(core_grid, ENCE_efficiency, type = "b", col = col_ence, pch = 15,
     ylim = c(0, 1), xlab = "Cores", ylab = "Efficiency (speedup / cores)",
     main = "Strong Scaling Efficiency: ENCE vs MICE")
lines(core_grid, MICE_efficiency, type = "b", col = col_mice, pch = 17)
abline(h = 1, col = "grey40", lty = 2)
grid()
legend("bottomleft", legend = c("ENCE", "MICE"), col = c(col_ence, col_mice), pch = c(15, 17), lty = 1)
```
